question: Education was shifted to the Concurrent List by which Constitutional Amendment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**42nd Amendment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **42nd Amendment Act, 1976**, is one of the most significant amendments to the Indian Constitution, brought during the Emergency period under the leadership of Prime Minister **Indira Gandhi**.
 
• It shifted the subject of **education** from the **State List** to the **Concurrent List** in the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution.
 
• This change meant that both the **Central** and **State Governments** could legislate on matters related to education, providing greater uniformity in education policies across the country.
 
• The amendment aimed to strengthen the role of the Central Government in ensuring a national framework for education while still involving the states in its implementation.
 
• Education being on the Concurrent List allowed for centralized policy-making, which was crucial for addressing issues like literacy, higher education standards, and equitable access to education across all states.
